A.question: ¿Puede añadirse fsync(dirfd) en puntos de publicación metadata de objetos y ledgers sin debilitar O_NOFOLLOW ni el modo privado?
A.acceptance: Every newly created shard must fsync parent directory; final SHA entry and temp unlink must fsync object shard; ledger file append has fsync(fd) plus fsync(root fd). Add offline regression that observes fsync on directories. Make no crash-atomicity claim.

rivals: File fsync enough; directory entries not necessarily persisted
Directory fsync can fail on unsupported FS, must fail closed and leave documented limits

C.experiment: Incremental patch existing secure_store.py and add test recording directory-fsync calls; verify GitHub blob SHA and do isolated POSIX os.fsync(dirfd) microtest. Preserve old permission checks and lock.

D.method: POSIX-only local; no external CI or hardware kill; source Python tests committed but full suite unrun
D.falsifier: No directory fd reaches fsync on newly created object+ledger or existing tests removed, or code allows a misleading release_grade.
